data.long_meaning: The name Hithansh is derived from Sanskrit, where Hitha means 'sun' and Ansh means 'radiance'. This name signifies the brilliance and luminosity of the sun. The name Hithansh carries the meaning “Sun's radiance” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Hithansh usually hope their child will grow to embody sun's radiance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
